forensic_audit_of_previous_discrepancy.observed_contradiction: 24h non-overlapping ANOVA reported p=0.8169 while Sprint 34.2 bootstrap reported p=0.0020.
forensic_audit_of_previous_discrepancy.root_cause_explanation: In Sprint 34.2, the bootstrap test statistic was evaluated by comparing an overlap-inflated test statistic (F=5.4137 on N=18,264 overlapping bars with 95.83% serial correlation) against a null distribution generated by bar-by-bar permutation of regime indices. The bar-by-bar permutation destroyed the persistence of regimes, forcing null F values to center around 1.0 (95% CI: [0.25, 2.05]). Consequently, 0 of 500 permutations exceeded 5.4137, leading to a spurious Laplace p-value of (0+1)/(500+1) = 0.0020. When evaluated correctly on the independent non-overlapping sample (N_eff=761), observed F=0.4452 and the permutation bootstrap p-value is 0.8172, in perfect harmony with the parametric p=0.8169. Furthermore, circular block shifting on overlapping data yields p=0.6647, confirming that the apparent F=5.4137 is entirely an artifact of serial overlap.
